scope: Global reusable specialist catalog, declarative public GitHub plugin manifest lifecycle, reviewed source pinning, template launch authorization and compact Agent/Plugin UI.
verdict: No blocking findings remain after actual Claude Opus 5.5 closure and passing backend/UI tests. Deployment and browser integration are assessed separately.

acceptedFindings.problem: Commit JSON with large patches could exceed the source response limit.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Use the documented SHA media type with a 64-byte streaming limit; anonymous real GitHub probe returned exactly 40 bytes.

acceptedFindings.problem: Malformed stored manifests/custom definitions could break the whole catalog and prevent removal.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Safe invalid DTOs remain visible and removable/editable, cannot launch or enable; tests cover malformed persisted rows.

acceptedFindings.problem: Invisible format and tag characters could evade human preview of model instructions.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Unicode Default_Ignorable_Code_Point and explicit control-character checks reject hidden content, with tag/filler/selector regressions.

acceptedFindings.problem: Saved combined instructions could leave no room for a task.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Static instruction budget reserves 8 KiB at template save and manifest validation; final launch remains bounded to 64 KiB.

acceptedFindings.problem: A skill update could make an existing custom specialist impossible to launch.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Preview and transactionally confirmed update resolve dependent skill texts, including disabled valid definitions, and reject excess budget; tests include concurrent template creation after preview.

acceptedFindings.problem: A model preference could be inherited for an incompatible or unspecified provider.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Either-provider templates inherit no model, concrete preferences only inherit for the same provider, explicit user model remains allowed; UI clears on provider changes.

acceptedFindings.problem: A shared template could prevent deletion of its creator.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Nullable created_by with ON DELETE SET NULL preserves the shared template; regression deletes a synthetic creator.

acceptedFindings.problem: Source hashes returning to their original values could make an old preview valid again.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Monotone installed revision participates in the preview base hash; X-to-Y-to-X regression rejects stale confirmation.

acceptedFindings.problem: All start failures locked the form indefinitely.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Only precise known preflight codes allow editing. Unknown/post-spawn outcomes retain the operation ID. Explicit confirmed new operation is available after session inspection.

rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.advice: Treat all HTTP 401/403/404 as safe preflight failures and automatically unlock a new operation.
rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.disposition: Rejected. Current authorization/snapshot checks can fail after spawn. Only explicit preflight codes are classified safe; an already uncertain operation remains uncertain on later preflight failure.

rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.advice: Require providerPreference as a hard provider restriction.
rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.disposition: Rejected. It is an explicit user-overridable preference, never a permission grant.

rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.advice: Create a migration for an earlier intermediate version of the new extension tables.
rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.disposition: Not applicable. Coordinator confirmed no intermediate version was deployed to persistent VM state.

preservedRequirements: Installation administrator and fresh passkey are required for global mutations; human members can launch only in authorized projects.
Specialists reuse instructions without sharing project files, memory, credentials or security profiles.
Plugin content is declarative text and fixed validated colors, with no executable Hub hooks, archives, shell, native provider config or secret handling.
Public GitHub only; numeric repository identity, full commit SHA and raw manifest digest pin reviewed contents; explicit expiring session-bound preview precedes installation/update.
Launch inherits project namespace/root/current permissions, verifies persisted assignment acknowledgement and avoids automatic duplicate starts.

primarySources.claim: Get a commit supports application/vnd.github.sha to return the commit SHA without the patch payload.
Relative luminance contrast threshold informs the 4.5:1 plugin theme text validation.

limits: This record evaluates reviewed code, not deployment success or completed browser integration.
Actual provider account consent and a full live public-plugin installation were not performed by this reviewer.
Synthetic stores and public read-only GitHub requests were used; no real user credentials or databases were inspected or modified.
Raw prompts and Claude responses remain outside the repository; only sanitized dispositions and hashes are recorded.
